report_title: Autonomous Decision Explainability & Telemetry Justification Report

traces.primary_hypothesis: Async worker concurrency bottleneck identified as dominant factor in queue depth accumulation (>20 items).
counterfactual_scenarios_evaluated: Do Nothing: Queue depth would exceed 60 items by 09:00 AM, violating P95 SLA.
Purge Queue: Irreversible document processing data loss (unacceptable risk).
traces.human_readable_rationale: Scaling worker concurrency from 32 to 48 directly addresses task starvation while remaining within container CPU allocation limits.

traces.primary_hypothesis: Memory fragmentation and stale embedding chunks causing elevated redis key eviction rates.
counterfactual_scenarios_evaluated: Expand Redis Memory: Requires cluster downtime/reprovisioning ($$$)
No Action: Risk of OOM kill on master Redis node.
traces.human_readable_rationale: Proactively flushing keys with TTL < 0 and expired embeddings frees 280MB of memory instantly with zero user impact.

traces.primary_hypothesis: Primary upstream LLM API experiencing regional latency degradation (P95 > 1800ms).
supporting_telemetry_evidence: log:http_status_429 received from primary endpoint (14 occurrences in 2m)
counterfactual_scenarios_evaluated: Retry Primary: Cascading failure and client-side timeouts.
Degrade to Stub: Degrades document classification accuracy.
traces.human_readable_rationale: Routing 30% canary traffic to secondary provider restores overall P95 latency to 420ms with identical semantic quality.
